notes.title: Hallo Ödländer
notes.content:
Hello my wastelanders,



Yes... it's been a long time since I last reported in and Fallen Sky Online is basically dead...
Now I would still like to make a small announcement here and announce Fallen Sky “Origins”.

FSOr will be developed on the same engine as the first part and will be an Mmorpg game.
It will be a little more complex or it is already more complex than the first part.
I have a small summary of the features:

-> 8 types of weapons
-> 40 different weapons
-> Anomaly powers (similar to spells)
-> 34 different armors
-> World events that are timed
-> Level cap up to Lv:50 (for now)
-> A large world map to explore
-> Guilds
-> Friends
-> Resources to mine or collect
-> Crafting system
-> PvP zones
-> 8 different character classes (each has its own anomaly power)


Now that's a little summary of what Fallen Sky Origins will be able to do.
The game itself is actually playable but I'm still improving the main quest.
I would also like to add some side quests.
And a few maps still need to be designed.

You can say that Fallen Sky Origins is about 70% finished.

In the next few days I'll be doing an alpha test with selected friends to see whether the configurations of the equipment and weapons match their skills and whether the game is reasonably fair.

Oh yeah... it's still in 2D xD
I'm not that good at 3D development and then something as complex as an mmorpg xD


In the next few days I will post a more detailed update with pictures of the current status of Fallen Sky Origins :)


Kind regards, my wastelanders
your Ipatix

notes.title: FSO Server File
notes.content:
Hello survivors,

I have now managed to sort out the problem with the server file. 
please uninstall the game and reinstall it on restarted Steam.
then start the game and then go to "Local Files" and manually open the file: server.sfx.exe 

When you've done that, go back to the FSO client and wait until "Online" appears in the lower left corner. 

So you can then play vial Local Host "Singleplayer".

Please note that at the moment it is only possible for the German voice output. 


I still need a little time for the English voice output.
I apologize.


~ James

notes.title: Fallen Sky "Stand Alone Server"
notes.content:
Hello Community,
Since there is no longer an Official FSO Server, I added a "Stand Alone" application of the game under "Tools" in your Steam menu. This is called "FallenSkyServer".
First start this application and then the main game as usual and you can lose yourself in the world of Fallen Sky Online.
Please note that you have to update the main game first!


best regards M.B

notes.title: Questhelper Update
notes.content:
Hello dear badlands,

After a few days of work I finally managed to implement Questhelper.
Thanks to Nyuu for reporting;)

The questelper are arrows that indicate the approximate direction to your quest targets.
They will only appear if I have to go to an assignment and not if you have to go back to the quest giver.
There are also no quest tokens if you are in a dungeon like (The Camp, Pennington Ltc., Pinewood LLC or Vault 22).
I decided that to challenge you a little in the Bad Kreuznach wasteland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33715446/cec1c1d1c4a429e92bafdee415e60697415e8769.png[/img]


I also fixed some walking data.



Changes:

-> Add questhelper
-> Change walking data Bad Kreuznach
-> Delete Pinklady Bazaar


What's next?

The next step is to integrate projectiles for weapons into the game.
Also a crafting system and the harvesting System


~ Marco

notes.title: Fallen Sky Online is back!
notes.content:
Hello dear community,

Fallen Sky Online is online again

We had to stop selling this game last October because there was a serious server error and I had no backup from an unfortunate situation.
But now I found a USB stick that looked so unlikely a few days ago and it was a backup of the server files on it from FSO.
Now we can roam the wasteland together again!

The only bad news I have is that all memory data is gone so you have to start the game all over again ... unfortunately ...


If you already have this game, uninstall it from your hard drive and download it again because I had to change something on the client.

In the future, Fallen Sky Online will also be translated into English, among other things, and there will be new events and content updates again.

~ your M.Braun, Earl of Sterling
